title: IEC 62304 and AI Coding Agents: Keeping the Record True
description: FDA recognizes IEC 62304 Edition 1.1 in full (13-79). What its premarket software guidance asks of the record once AI coding agents write medical device code.
og_alt: Mneme HQ card: IEC 62304 meets AI coding agents, on keeping the medical device software record true when agents write code.

reciprocal.desc: How an AI coding agent touches the FDA premarket software record for medical devices, and the checks that keep that record true.
For the device software itself, not production or quality system software: what IEC 62304 and the FDA premarket software guidance ask of the record once agents write code.
A regulated medical device case of lifecycle governance: keeping the software record true when AI coding agents write device code.
